verdict.rationale: Smooth states a CAPTCHA stance: its intro docs claim 'Auto-CAPTCHA solvers' that bypass challenges automatically, and community comments confirm this is a marketed feature. Beyond that one line, there is no dedicated CAPTCHA doc. Nothing explains coverage, failure behavior or error signaling. The live-view takeover could plausibly serve as a human fallback, but it is never documented for CAPTCHAs. Missing for 10: a dedicated CAPTCHA docs page, documented behavior and error reporting when solving fails, an explicit human-in-the-loop CAPTCHA fallback, and independent hands-on corroboration that solving works.
